title.es: Aquel de los dolores de cabeza
title.en: The One With the Recurring Headaches

description.es: Marta nota angustiada a Fina durante el desayuno. Fina reclama a Tasio el engaño a Carmen. Fina visita a Claudia en la colonia, y esta la convence de ir con Miguel al dispensario para atenderse de dolores de cabeza recurrentes. Fina le confiesa a Miguel que ha tenido brucelosis y este le pide analíticas para comprobar que la enfermedad no ha regresado.
description.en: Marta notices that Fina seems distressed during breakfast. Fina confronts Tasio over his deception of Carmen. Fina visits Claudia in the colony, and she convinces her to go with Miguel to the dispensary to be seen for recurring headaches. Fina confesses to Miguel that she had brucellosis, and he asks her for blood tests to check that the illness has not returned.
